review_kind: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5), no native-speaker signoff
note: Instruction 316, maintainer decision 2026-09-25, third to fifth passes 2026-09-26, sixth pass 2026-09-27: runtime (GUI) translation debt written and technically reviewed by AI against the English source and its code context. No human and no native speaker has read these rows.

records.key: An object is an outlier when it scores beyond this quantile of the control objects, so this share of controls is normal by construction. Wells are ranked by their share of outliers. Default 0.99.
records.source: An object is an outlier when it scores beyond this quantile of the control objects, so this share of controls is normal by construction. Wells are ranked by their share of outliers. Default 0.99.
records.translation: Un objeto es atípico cuando su puntuación supera este cuantil de los objetos de control, de modo que esta proporción de controles es normal por construcción. Los pocillos se ordenan por su proporción de atípicos. Valor predeterminado: 0.99.

records.key: How unlike the controls an object is: robust Mahalanobis distance, mean distance to the nearest control objects, an isolation forest, or low density under a Gaussian mixture. All run on the CPU. Default Robust Mahalanobis.
records.source: How unlike the controls an object is: robust Mahalanobis distance, mean distance to the nearest control objects, an isolation forest, or low density under a Gaussian mixture. All run on the CPU. Default Robust Mahalanobis.
records.translation: Cuán distinto de los controles es un objeto: distancia de Mahalanobis robusta, distancia media a los objetos de control más cercanos, un bosque de aislamiento o baja densidad bajo una mezcla gaussiana. Todos se ejecutan en la CPU. Valor predeterminado: Robust Mahalanobis.

records.key: Model the negative-control objects as normal and score every object and well for how unlike them it is, over every numeric feature (or the emb_ embedding columns when present). Needs a per-object table, the negative control picked above and well positions. Default off.
records.source: Model the negative-control objects as normal and score every object and well for how unlike them it is, over every numeric feature (or the emb_ embedding columns when present). Needs a per-object table, the negative control picked above and well positions. Default off.
records.translation: Modela los objetos del control negativo como normales y puntúa cada objeto y pocillo según cuán distinto sea de ellos, sobre cada variable numérica (o las columnas de incrustación emb_ si existen). Requiere una tabla por objeto, el control negativo elegido arriba y las posiciones de los pocillos. Valor predeterminado: desactivado.

records.key: Pick the control column and the negative control to score anomalies against.
records.source: Pick the control column and the negative control to score anomalies against.
records.translation: Elija la columna de control y el control negativo con los que puntuar las anomalías.

records.key: Score anomalies against the negative control
records.source: Score anomalies against the negative control
records.translation: Puntuar anomalías frente al control negativo

records.key: Turn on anomaly scoring and name the negative control.
records.source: Turn on anomaly scoring and name the negative control.
records.translation: Active la puntuación de anomalías e indique el control negativo.

records.key: Wells (A01), plate wells (prc) or treatment names that are known hits, separated by commas. With the positive control they give the AUROC of the ranking against the negative control. Default empty.
records.source: Wells (A01), plate wells (prc) or treatment names that are known hits, separated by commas. With the positive control they give the AUROC of the ranking against the negative control. Default empty.
records.translation: Pocillos (A01), pocillos de placa (prc) o nombres de tratamiento que son hallazgos conocidos, separados por comas. Con el control positivo dan el AUROC de la clasificación frente al control negativo. Valor predeterminado: vacío.

records.key: Write the ranked wells, every object's score, the top outliers and the review figure into a folder.
records.source: Write the ranked wells, every object's score, the top outliers and the review figure into a folder.
records.translation: Escribir en una carpeta los pocillos ordenados, la puntuación de cada objeto, los principales atípicos y la figura de revisión.
